sights.n: Busena Marine Park Underwater Observatory, Nago (ブセナ海中公園 海中展望塔)
sights.w: Opened in 1970 at the tip of Busena Cape, the observatory stands 170 m offshore at the end of a footbridge; a spiral stair descends to round windows 5 m below the surface for watching reef fish. Glass-bottom boats run from the same park.
sights.k: Walk down to the reef 5 m underwater

sights.n: Wajī Spring Cliffs & Lookout, Ie Island (湧出展望台)
sights.address: Near 3674 Agarie-ue, Ie-son, Kunigami-gun, Okinawa 905-0502, Japan
sights.w: Fresh water wells up at the foot of 60 m-plus cliffs on Ie Island's north coast — the island's main water source until an undersea pipeline came from the main island; the free lookout is the island's best viewpoint after Mt Gusuku, reaching to Iheya and Izena on clear days.

A hands-on culture village of old Okinawan farmhouses moved here from around the islands, recreating pre-war village life; visitors try indigo dyeing, pottery, weaving and bingata stencil-dyeing and watch Ryukyuan performing-arts shows.
